check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点打卡，连续打卡满 7 天解锁新场景。

dialogue.en: Thanks everyone for joining. Quick reminder — this is blameless. We're here to learn, not to point fingers.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: blameless / point fingers 是复盘的关键词，先定调
dialogue.zh: 谢谢大家来。先提醒一下——这是 blameless 复盘，我们是来学习的，不是来追责的。

dialogue.en: Appreciate that. So, what happened on Tuesday?
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。好，周二到底发生了什么？

dialogue.en: At 2:15 PM, latency on the Drova pipeline spiked to 40 seconds. The Storm 2 topology kept up, but the downstream consumer couldn't drain fast enough.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 先讲事实和时间线，不加主观判断
dialogue.zh: 下午 2:15，Drova pipeline 的延迟 spike 到 40 秒。Storm 2 的 topology 本身扛住了，但下游 consumer 消费不过来。

dialogue.en: Right, I saw the alerts. What was the root cause?
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 对，我看到告警了。root cause 是什么？

dialogue.en: Two things. First, the traffic replay hit a hot partition we hadn't seen in synthetic tests. Second, our autoscaling was too conservative — it kicked in 10 minutes late.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: Two things. First... Second... 结构清晰，适合讲 root cause
dialogue.zh: 两个原因。第一，流量重放打到了一个 synthetic 测试里没见过的 hot partition。第二，我们的 autoscaling 太保守了——晚了 10 分钟才启动。

dialogue.en: That makes sense. The hot partition explains why only one region was affected.
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.zh: 有道理。hot partition 就解释了为什么只有一个 region 受影响。

dialogue.en: Exactly. Now, what could we have done differently?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: what could we have done differently 是复盘的标准引导句
dialogue.zh: 没错。那么，我们本可以怎么做得不一样？

dialogue.en: We should add a hot-partition check to the pre-prod checklist.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 我们应该在 pre-prod checklist 里加一项 hot partition 检查。

dialogue.en: Good idea. And I'll tune the autoscaling thresholds this week — that one's on me.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: that one's on me 是主动认领的说法，真诚不甩锅
dialogue.zh: 好主意。autoscaling 阈值我这周来调——这个算我的。

dialogue.en: Perfect. So action items: me on autoscaling, Maya on the checklist. Let's revisit next retro. Thanks everyone — really good discussion.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 结尾分配 action items + 约下次回顾，复盘的标准收尾
dialogue.zh: 很好。action items：我负责 autoscaling，Maya 负责 checklist。下次 retro 我们再回顾。谢谢大家——讨论得很好。

key_phrases.en: This is blameless. We're here to learn, not to point fingers.
key_phrases.note: 复盘开场定调：对事不对人
key_phrases.zh: 这是 blameless 复盘，我们是来学习的，不是追责的。

key_phrases.note: 讲 root cause 的清晰结构

key_phrases.en: What could we have done differently?
key_phrases.note: 复盘的标准引导句，把讨论引向改进
key_phrases.zh: 我们本可以怎么做得不一样？

key_phrases.note: 约定下次回顾，形成闭环
key_phrases.zh: 下次 retro 我们再回顾。

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS 逐句跟读，重点练 blameless / point fingers 的发音
替换练习 5 分钟：把 hot partition 换成你经历过的一个真实线上问题，大声讲一遍 timeline
复盘模拟 5 分钟：从 Thanks everyone for joining 开始，一个人演完 12 句，重点练定调和收尾
roleplay_zh: 假设上周你的 pipeline 出了一个延迟 spike。用英文主持一个 3 分钟的 blameless 复盘：定调、讲 timeline、说 root cause、引导大家提改进、分配 action items、收尾。
scene_zh: Drova pipeline 线上延迟 spike 后的 blameless 复盘，参会的是 Tom 和 Maya。目标是对事不对人：讲清 timeline、找到 root cause、定下 action items。
title: Incident Postmortem
